acceptance: SUCCESS is published only if all seven calls return, all seven returned calls validate, and all custody checks pass; status then is COMPLETED_AWAITING_FRESH_ACTUAL_RESULT_AUDIT, never proof or ledger acceptance. A returned call that fails validation is preserved as a raw calls[] entry with validationStatus=FAILED_VALIDATION and validationError, counted in aikenCallsReturned but not in aikenCallsValidated/validatedCallsCount, and the run remains FAILED. Any failure preserves partial logs and counters, launches no further call, and permits no retry.
authoritySeparation: This proposal grants no authority. Root first materializes this R2 source as a new sibling, fills the literal operator SHA-256 placeholder before audit only, then a fresh full non-author source/effect/resource audit of all changed R2 bytes and consequences plus substantive votes, then a root adoption record requiring that the already-closed fresh actual-input audit (00e128, root adoption 6a86c215) is asserted accepted, then an exact new AUTH. This source author approves nothing and no future audit file, hash or vote is read or invented here. No M10, RR10 or T10 root has been created by this author and the future roots remain the same exact uncreated roots as in R1.

budgets.note: Per-call VM ExBudget::default() is the Aiken default, separate from these OS limits. No uninterruptible-death or transitive-CPU claim is made. The 600 s whole-operator bound plus 10 s kill-after is enforced by root as the outer bound (420 planned aggregate plus 180 reserve), not as an internal 700 s sum.

command.calls: Exactly seven sequential calls in K10-T1..T7 order, one attempt each, zero retries, launch intent counted before Popen. Launch intent is not native start: nativeExecutableStarted remains not_measured. A process that returns is appended and counted as returned before validation; a spawn or wait/cleanup failure without return remains incompleteCall plus the attempt counter with no phantom returned call.
command.contextPassing: Each 2649-byte context file is read with a bounded read, hash-checked, strict-UTF-8 decoded, exactly one trailing newline stripped if present, required single-line, and passed as exactly one argv element. No shell and no string evaluation.
command.forbidden: No --flat, --debug or any other guessed flag; no subprocess shell; no additional debug JSON mode.

custody: SHA-256 of all eleven host pins (tool, data manifest, nine generated inputs), the staged read-only tool (mode 555) and all five operator files are checked before and after. In addition, verify_custody rechecks exactly the nine staged input files under LOCAL/inputs (size, SHA-256, non-link regular file, read-only mode) through the one literal INPUT_STAGED_REL mapping at staging/pre-native time and again post-native, including on the failure path once staging is complete (created=true). Writable, symlinked, missing or changed staged inputs fail closed. Inputs under the local inputs directory must already be read-only staged by root. A wrong size or hash fails before any command.
explicitNonClaims: Local fabricated 2222../555.. outref/claimant, zero fee and builder-chosen expiry 1893456000000 (2030) are FABRICATED/UNBOUND; no ledger, fee, conservation, min-ADA, admission, wallet, signing or Preprod claim.
Local VM cpu/mem are not qualified node ledger ExUnits and support no fee or tx-fit claim.
Header parse and vkey matrix setup are Class-0 forgeable; no trusted ceremony is inferred.

All 20 UTxO families, ACTUS 277/18/32, DeFi 72 and general obligations, real recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent universal work and real Preprod remain open. No percentage of full compatibility.
generatedInputs: Nine files already generated once by the ordinary R2 adapter (exit 0, one attempt, no retry; source/input pins unchanged): script.hex, manifest.json and seven 2649-byte contexts, all pinned literally in AUTH-CANDIDATE.json. Their fresh actual data audit is now CLOSED as ordinary data by review 00e1287c1448ec9179794c95c9dca9780e551f806ffab9f02415bdad1e7f1f79 and root adoption 6a86c215244afded16cff28c725ab54e697d67119a293c38ca9697ac0f903c5f; the candidate AUTH attestation remains the historical PENDING string so this candidate still cannot run, and root asserts acceptance only in a new AUTH after the fresh full R2 source audit.
isolation: bwrap --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session --clearenv with only the tool read-only at /tool, the nine inputs read-only at /inputs, a fresh capture directory writable at /capture, minimal /dev, /proc and /tmp, and minimal environment. No network, stdlib/build/validators, wallet, host home, /usr mounts, keys, RNG, prover, LLVM or cargo.
negativeParser: Accept only exit exactly 1, empty stdout, and full-match stderr: blank line, Error, -----, the exact text 'the validator crashed / exited prematurely', Costs with positive integer cpu/memory, and at most one bounded Logs section with no unexplained trailing content. OutOfExError ('execution went over budget'), syntax/Miette errors, signals, timeouts and any other nonzero shape fail closed.
objective: Evaluate the actual already-compiled C2 mint wrapper with its genuine published proof/VK and raw PlutusV3 ScriptContext terms under the independently recomputed compiled policy 6a4b67e7d46dbada1b4f49dd324018324b60b13bebbeb6f33d9d59c1 already bound in the contexts; no old local a2 policy is substituted and no Env settle-A2 statement is blindly replaced.
positiveParser: Accept T1 only on exit 0, empty stderr, and stdout strict JSON with exactly result/cpu/mem, result exactly (con unit ()), and non-bool positive integer cpu/mem.
prerequisiteOrder: fresh actual-input audit accepts the nine generated inputs (CLOSED: 00e128 review plus root adoption 6a86c215; candidate attestation remains historical PENDING)
root materializes this R2 source as a new sibling, fills literal operator SHA before audit only, records source manifest

r2Repair: Three minimal repairs over R1 7d591c1e: (1) staging resolves staged names only through one literal INPUT_STAGED_REL mapping for exactly nine roles derived from the frozen EXPECTED roster, with no eager dict.get default; (2) verify_custody rechecks the nine staged inputs at staging and post-native including the failure path once staging is complete; (3) a raw returned step is appended and counted before validation, preserving validationStatus/validationError and distinct returned versus validated counts. No new native authority, budget reset, build, probe, stdlib, cargo, SDK, proof, setup, key, wallet, network, signing or ledger path is added.
